display_long_description:
DataMesh One is an application focused on 3D and mixed reality content display and collaboration, providing an immersive spatial experience. It, together with DataMesh Studio (a zero-code 3D+XR content creation tool), forms the DataMesh Director—a powerful process design and training tool that significantly enhances communication and training efficiency.

----- Application Scenarios -----

[Educational Training]
Combines fast 3D content editing with hands-on demonstrations, effectively used in various educational and vocational training scenarios. Virtual devices replace physical ones, significantly reducing costs.

[After-Sales Support]
Enhances after-sales service experience through a combination of virtual and real product operation demonstrations, achieving dual optimization of cost and efficiency.

[Maintenance Guidance]
Accurate 3D models and step-by-step instructions ensure that technicians can perform maintenance on equipment and facilities efficiently and accurately.

[Marketing Display]
Large-scale mixed reality (MR) experience provides a comprehensive 3D display of product variations, suitable for various large exhibition scenarios.

[Remote Collaboration]
Multi-device MR remote collaboration and design with synchronized 3D content, reducing ineffective communication.
